lines.text: Rain starts on a grey street, first drops darkening the pavement.
@maya_front stops mid-stride and glances up at the sky.
The patter quickens. Strangers hurry for cover.
Rain drums on the canopy while she stays dry.
Puddles ripple at her feet as the street turns silver.
@maya_front smiles and walks on through the downpour.

writes.note: I drafted a short visual scene from your line, with no dialogue, built around Maya and the umbrella.

reply.rationale: Expanded the one-line rain idea into a single-location 15 s scene (about 14 s by the timing rule) using only the listed refs, kept visual with no spoken line.
